description: Unit test class for the DittoAckRequestsFilter component, testing its behavior in filtering acknowledgment request headers.

classes.name: DittoAckRequestsFilterTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of DittoAckRequestsFilter.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DittoAckRequestsFilter instances are immutable.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutMatchingHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Checks that a non-matching header returns the original value unaltered.

methods.name: filterValueWithTwinPersistedOnlyAckRequest
methods.description: Validates filtering when the acknowledgment request contains only TWIN_PERSISTED label.

methods.name: filterEmptyStringValue
methods.description: Ensures that an empty header value results in a null return.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutDittoInternalRequests
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgment requests without internal Ditto labels are returned unchanged.

methods.name: filterValueWithDittoInternalRequests
methods.description: Checks filtering to remove internal Ditto acknowledgment labels from the list.

methods.name: filterValueWithEmptyAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Tests that acknowledgment requests with empty labels are removed from the array.
